title: Over-Permissive Group/Role Assignments (Windows & Linux) (Consider JIT Authentication)
description: Users assigned to overly-permissive groups or roles (e.g., local or domain administrators, sudoers with NOPASSWD) increase blast radius when compromised. Implementing Just-in-Time (JIT) elevation reduces standing privileges.
businessImpact: High --- excessive privileges enable privilege escalation, lateral movement, and persistent control over systems.
remediation:
- Remove unnecessary users from privileged groups.
- Implement Just-in-Time (JIT) access controls for elevated tasks.
- Require MFA for administrative elevation.
- Audit group memberships and enforce least-privilege regularly.
